bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
P=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
CONTAINERS=$(docker ps --filter ancestor=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.ID}}' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
test "$CONTAINERS" = 1 || exit 31
CID=$(docker ps --filter ancestor=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.ID}}' | head -1)
PROJECT=$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}')
SERVICE=$(docker inspect "$CID" --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}')
test "$SERVICE" = gaybbs || exit 32
test -n "$PROJECT" && test "$PROJECT" != "<no value>" || exit 33
OV=$(mktemp --suffix=.yaml); trap 'rm -f "$OV"' EXIT
printf 'services:\n  gaybbs:\n    image: gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:posting-menu-fix-662522a\n' > "$OV"
OUT=$(docker compose -p "$PROJECT" -f "$P/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -f "$OV" run --rm --no-deps gaybbs node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/recolorPublishedPostingMenus.mjs 2>&1) || { echo POSTING_MENU_DRY_RUN_FAILED; exit 34; }
INVENTORY=$(printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep '^POSTING_MENU_INVENTORY ' | tail -1)
test -n "$INVENTORY" || exit 35
gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body "GAYBBS_POSTING_MENU_DRY_RUN_20261113 compose_project=$PROJECT service=$SERVICE $INVENTORY" >/dev/null
echo POSTING_MENU_DRY_RUN_COMPLETE
